# Example Program 4 — College Track Athlete, Late-Stage Return from Patellar Tendonitis (Cleared for Plyos/Full-Speed Work)

*Raw program as written by the coach. Preserved as-written to serve as a few-shot example for AI program generation — do not edit for "correctness," only to fix transcription errors. Two blocks as given: a prep/warm-up circuit, then the main session.*

**Context: this athlete is almost fully recovered and has been cleared to return to plyometrics and full-speed activity — this represents the LATE stage of the tendon-pain progression in Section 5 of the Coaching Philosophy doc (isometric → slow controlled resistance → plyometrics), not the initial or middle stage. Do not use this as a template for an athlete with active/reactive tendon pain.**

---

## Prep / Warm-Up Circuit

| Exercise | Cues | Sets x Reps |
|---|---|---|
| Stability Ball Rollout | | 1x12 |
| Banded Squat (3-3-3 tempo) | | 1x6 |
| Barbell Complex — RDL, Bent-Over Row, Upright Row, Front Squat | | 1x5 each |
| Depth Drop | | 1x8 |

## Main Session

| Exercise | Cues | Sets x Reps |
|---|---|---|
| Hang Power Clean | | 3x3 |
| Hurdle Hop to Box Jump | | 3x3 |
| Back Squat | | 4x3 |
| Bench Press | | 3x5 |
| Nordic Hamstring Curl | | 3x5 |
| Weighted Pull-Up | | 3x5 |
| Pistol Squat (Goblet-loaded) | | 3x5/side |
| Single-Leg Calf Raise | | 2x10/side |
| Table Hip Flexor Lift | | 2x10/side |
